Cost: 15,000eb (Super Luxury)
Covers: Body
SP: 16
Armor Penalty: -1 REF, -2 DEX, -2 MOVE

Ablation it suffers is reduced by 1 (minimum 0), and Martial Arts attacks and Special Moves don't halve its SP. Has 1 Option Slot for External Body Cyberware that ignores installation requirements (including being an FBC and option slots), but not cyberware that grants or restores SP. While worn you can use that cyberware with no Humanity Loss and without using your own option slots. Can take Subdermal Armor Cyberware Enhancements. Repairs 1 lost SP at the end of each day it loses none.

Foundry notes:

  • Corgo's penalty is -1 REF, -2 DEX, -2 MOVE. The sheet applies one penalty to all three stats, so it uses -2; add the difference back by hand for the lighter stat(s).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
